title: A suitcase from your own wardrobe
description: The chosen clothes, the finished combinations and the packing marks in a space of their own for the trip.

blocks.text: In the general library it is easy to suggest clothes a person never meant to take.

quote.text: I just finished digitizing my closet; this app is so fun and useful! It's so nice to be able to see all my clothes wherever I am so I can plan outfits whenever I have a spare minute (or reference it when shopping). I especially love the packing list feature, it is so helpful!

blocks.text: Limit the selection to what is in the suitcase, show how each item is used and which outfits a swap affects. Distinguish “chosen” from “packed.”
A change to the trip should not change the whole catalog and the everyday wear history.
